subject: Evaluation artifacts exchange & MAP — RetailCo
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@retailco.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Evaluation artifacts exchange — RetailCo

Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and rollout controls. As discussed, we want to run a 4-week evaluation to validate retrieval/agent prompts and model behavior on our merchandising and returns data.

To move forward we can share: a) a 50k-row sample of anonymized transactions (CSV), b) a prompt pack with 120 seed prompts, and c) a small test-case suite for edge behaviors. Before we send anything we need a mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the timeline, usage constraints, and an NDA/TOU for dataset handling.

Can you send a MAP draft and a brief checklist of what you need on our side (file formats, S3 presigned, RBAC for staging)? We prefer data transfer week of Dec 21 and a go/no-go decision by Jan 15. Procurement (cc'd procurement@retailco.com) will handle any contract paperwork.

Attachments: RetailCo_eval_spec_v1.pdf (overview of datasets/sample rows)

Thanks,
Alice Jenkins
Head of ML Platform — RetailCo
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@retailco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-11T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation artifacts exchange — RetailCo

Hi Alice — great to hear. Putting a short MAP outline below and attaching our template so your legal/procurement can review. High level proposal: 

- Week of Dec 21: secure transfer of sample CSV + prompt pack to Redwood staging (S3 presigned link or secure sFTP)
- Dec 22–Dec 31: onboarding & smoke tests (access, schema validation, prompt formatting checks)
- Jan 2–Jan 9: parallel evaluation run (automated testcases + manual checks)
- Jan 12: internal review and quality gate
- Jan 15: go/no-go decision and walk-through with stakeholders

Usage constraints (short):
- Artifacts provided for evaluation only; no distribution outside evaluation team
- No production re-training or model weight updates using provided data
- Prompts/testcases may be used for internal quality tuning of serving configuration only
- Redwood will retain evaluation logs for 30 days unless otherwise agreed

I'll attach: Redwood_MAP_template.xlsx (MAP with milestones), data_transfer_packet.md (format/namespace checklist). Rafael I looped in to confirm security/ops details and Ben for procurement handoff.

Related links: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketplace/MAP-template

Let me know if those timing constraints look ok and whether you prefer DocuSign or a standard SOW.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@retailco.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-14T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation artifacts exchange — RetailCo

Hi Alice / Vanessa — quick operational notes and a couple of redlines from Security: 

- Request: a minimal data schema doc with column-level descriptions and confirmation that all PII has been removed (or tokenization details included). The RetailCo_eval_spec_v1.pdf is a good start but we need a signed attestation for the anonymization step.
- Staging access: we can provide a time-limited role scoped to evaluation buckets; please confirm the AWS account ID or preferred S3 host.
- Retention: default 30-day log retention; can be extended to 90 days with an addendum (procurement).
- Prompt packs: if RetailCo includes proprietary prompts, we need a short licensing note that they are provided for evaluation only and cannot be redistributed.

Quoted for context:
> On Dec 11, 2026, Vanessa Ortiz wrote:
> > Usage constraints (short):
> > - Artifacts provided for evaluation only; no distribution outside evaluation team
> > - No production re-training or model weight updates using provided data
>
Proposed small change: add a clause that Redwood may use anonymized evaluation signal (feature-level metrics, not user data) to improve serving heuristics, with explicit opt-out. Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@retailco.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@retailco.com
Date: 2026-12-18T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation artifacts exchange — RetailCo

Vanessa / Rafael — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement is comfortable with the MAP skeleton; they asked us to confirm the attestation and the DocuSign route (we prefer DocuSign). We will: 

- Send the attestation confirming PII removal by EOD Dec 20
- Upload: RetailCo_promptpack_v0.zip and the anonymized CSV sample to the S3 presigned link you provide during the week of Dec 21
- Agree to the usage constraints you proposed with the additional opt-out for Redwood using aggregated, non-identifiable signals — RetailCo will opt-out for this pilot (we will re-evaluate later).

Procurement contact is Sarah Li (procurement@retailco.com) and they will complete the DocuSign for the MAP and SOW. Once you send the S3 location and the DocuSign link we will queue the transfer.

Attachments: RetailCo_promptpack_v0.zip

Best regards,
Alice Jenkins
Head of ML Platform — RetailCo
